abstract: Two studies in this issue of Cell, by Bintu et al. and Brann et al., overturn the long-standing zonal model of olfactory receptor organization. Using image-based spatial transcriptomics, they reveal that receptors occupy reproducible positions along continuous gradients, coupling receptor choice to axonal targeting through a shared molecular code.
